description: Source code for a red-black tree implementation within jemalloc, including functions for creating, initializing, allocating, deleting, and traversing rtree nodes and leaves, with support for cache management and subtree deletion.

methods.name: rtree_new
methods.description: Initializes a new rtree, optionally zeroed, and initializes its mutex lock.

methods.name: rtree_delete
methods.description: Deletes the entire rtree subtree if RTREE_HEIGHT > 1.

methods.name: rtree_leaf_elm_lookup_hard
methods.description: Performs a hard lookup of a leaf element in the rtree based on a key, traversing nodes and managing cache.

methods.name: rtree_ctx_data_init
methods.description: Initializes the rtree context cache data structures.
